messages:
Lea (Sales): Heads up — we have a 2-week POC with a large financial customer (regional bank). They want a dedicated GPU pool for inference, low-latency chat use. Can we provision something in eu-west1 this week?

Omar (Solutions Eng): What does the workload look like? avg tokens per request, sequence length, expected concurrency? that will affect SKU reccomendation.

Lea (Sales): Mostly chat, ~64-256 tokens per response, peak concurrency ~12-18 rps, average qps ~6. Model target is an Llama-derivative 13B.

Maya (Infra Ops): eu-west1 availability for A100-40GB is limited today. We can do A100 x2 for baseline but lead time ~24-48h. Cheaper alternative A10G or H100 depending on region. Do you need burst capacity?

Lea (Sales): Customer asked for guaranteed perf during demos — want baseline of 2 GPUs and ability to burst to 6 for demo windows. SLA for POC?

Sarah (Account Exec): We can document a POC commitment for 2 weeks. For bursts we should size reserved pool with autoscale to allow +4 GPUs for demos. Pricing-wise we should offer a trial discount. Finance needs SKU/unit pricing from infra.

Omar (Solutions Eng): For 13B and 256 token tails, A100-40GB gives best latency. If cost is concern, A10G has slightly higher latency but may be acceptable for POC. Suggest config: 2x A100-40GB (baseline), autoscale cap at 6, min-burst warmers for demos. Also enable KV-cache and batching config: batching target ~50ms.

Nina (Security): FinServ — we need SOC2 + encryption at rest with customer-managed KMS. Any PHI/PII? Also requirement: VPC peering and IP allowlist, audit logs retention 90d. If they require PCI-level controls we might need Private deployment instead of hosted Dedicated.

Lea (Sales): Customer will share security questionnaire — they are strict but starting with non-prod data. They want VPC peering, KMS, and API key scoped to the POC project. Not PCI.

Jon (Onboarding): For VPC peering we'll need their CIDR and contact. Who will own the API keys? We should create a scoped key and give read-only telemetry to them. Also want static egress IPs for allowlisting.

Maya (Infra Ops): Actionable items for provisioning: region=eu-west1, baseline sku=A100-40GB x2, autoscale max=6, quantization profile for 13B (FP16 -> O2). Need VPC peering set up request (ticket) and KMS key ARN. I can queue pool if we confirm SKU and burst policy.

provision-bot: Provision request created: PR-2026-4397 (eu-west1, 2x A100-40GB, burst to 6). ETA initial pool: 36h.

Nina (Security): I'll review their questionnaire once provided. Please flag any required controls that we can't meet in hosted Dedicated — I'll advise if Private is needed.

Lea (Sales): Great — I'll collect their CIDR and security doc and post here. Can we lock in pricing for POC? Need a one-page quote.

Sarah (Account Exec): I'll draft a POC quote and include a 50% trial discount on usage and complimentary observability for duration. Sending it to legal for a simple MSA addendum.

Omar (Solutions Eng): Once pool is provisioned, I'll run a quick perf run and share sample throughput numbers and the recommended batching/cache settings.

Maya (Infra Ops): Noted. I'll update PR-2026-4397 with region availability and expected start time. If A100 capacity shifts, we'll fallback to A10G and notify.

Lea (Sales): Thanks everyone — next step: I will upload customer CIDR + questionnaire by EOD. Omar/Jon please standby for testing and key rotation. :thumbsup:
